title: Data collection
subtitle: Upload, validate and classify activity and emissions data from every source before it reaches review.
modulesHint: Each module opens at its own address

org-setup.title: Organisation setup
org-setup.subtitle: Tenant, boundaries and frameworks
org-setup.desc: Configure the organisational boundary, reporting frameworks (GRI, CSRD, ISSB, CN-SSE), business groups, facilities and emission-source registration.

raw-supplier.title: Raw data upload
raw-supplier.subtitle: Excel / CSV ingestion and column mapping
raw-supplier.desc: Upload raw GHG activity data in any layout. Column detection maps your spreadsheet to the standard emissions data model before validation.

measured.title: Measured data
measured.subtitle: CEMS, meters, labs and verified data
measured.desc: Continuous emission monitoring, utility meter readings, lab results and third-party verified totals, classified by data quality.

entities.title: Entity submissions
entities.subtitle: Intercompany, subsidiary and supplier data
entities.desc: Collect figures from divisions, subsidiaries and suppliers on standard templates. Track each submission and validate on upload.
